- **DevContext.AI / Klarity** (devcontext.rounakneema.in): AI repository intelligence that analyzes codebases to generate mock interviews.
- **AXIOM OS** (axiom-os.rounakneema.in): Zero-cloud personal OS layer focusing on behavioral telemetry and accountability.
- **Dizzy** (dizzy.rounakneema.in): Voice-to-Figma generative UI via Figma MCP.
